tech_stack.name: SQL Server

conventions: Respond to the user in Simplified Chinese.
Public repository contract is glowflow.DataRepository in repository.go.
Definition objects use Chain* naming; do not restore FlowDefinition or FlowMetadata.
SQL schema uses chain_no, not chain_id.
SQL constants for glue/xdb templates should use first-line --sql markers where applicable.
SQL Server reserved/bracketed columns should be aliased for stable Go scan mapping.
Tests are Go package tests run with go test; go vet ./... currently exits 0.

hard: Do not implement code during planning phase.
Use apply_patch for later file edits.
Do not revert unrelated user changes.
Do not add database foreign key constraints.
Keep chain_no naming throughout xdb code.
soft: Keep changes scoped to contrib/repository/xdb and focused tests unless validation requires metadata updates.
Prefer repository-level behavior tests before implementation.
Preserve existing public API style and avoid broad jsonfile repository work.
compatibility: LoadChainDefinitions and LoadChainDefinition return public glowflow.ChainDefinition values.
ChainDefinition.Endpoints has no SQL source in current DDL and should remain empty unless requirements change.
Nullable SQL fields and nullable JSON text need safe mapping without scan panics.
security_requirements: Do not log database credentials or connection names beyond existing non-secret names.
Use parameterized DAO inputs for chain_no filters; do not concatenate user input into SQL.

patterns: Root package owns public definition structs and repository interface.
contrib/repository/xdb should be an optional SQL-backed DataRepository adapter.
xdb.go resolves glue.DB(dbConnName), delegates queries to daos, then assembles public ChainDefinition values.
daos package uses xdb.Executer.QueryAs with SQL constants from sqls package.
sql.mssql.sql defines table relationships in columns/indexes only; no database FKs by convention.

key_components.name: DataRepository contract
responsibility: Return public ChainDefinition values without leaking xdb row models.

key_components.name: Public definition model
responsibility: Declare ChainDefinition, ChainMetadata, NodeDefinition, ConnectionDefinition, Layout.
Define JSON-shaped output that repository adapters assemble.

key_components.name: SQL Server schema
responsibility: Define flow_chain_definition and flow_chain_version metadata tables.
Define flow_chain_node and flow_chain_connection version-scoped topology tables.
Define flow_node_definition, flow_layout_definition, and flow_basic_infra support tables.

key_components.name: XDB repository skeleton
responsibility: Create repository from db connection name.
Load all chain rows, node rows, connection rows, then build ChainDefinition output.
Currently has unimplemented LoadChainDefinition and buildChainDefinition.

key_components.name: XDB DAO layer
responsibility: Query row models with glue/xdb Executer.
Currently calls empty SQL constants and lacks scoped latest-version loading.

purpose: Authoritative source for xdb table names, columns, nullability, indexes, and descriptions.
Defines flow_chain_definition, flow_chain_version, flow_chain_node, flow_chain_connection, flow_node_definition, flow_layout_definition, flow_basic_infra.
LoadChainDefinitions is skeletal and LoadChainDefinition/buildChainDefinition are nil.
LoadChainDefinitions, LoadChainNodes, and LoadChainConnections are currently empty strings.
Current QueryAs calls use nil params and all-row loaders only.
Currently has only Id and Name, missing schema fields and version-scoped chain node data.
Public output target for assembled data.
ChainDefinition has ID, Version, Metadata, Endpoints, Nodes, and Connections.
Public repository interface source of truth.
No version parameter is available for single-chain loading.

gotchas.text: flow_chain_definition and flow_chain_version duplicate metadata; executable output likely needs version rows because nodes/connections reference version_id.
LoadChainDefinition has only chainID input; latest-version behavior must be pinned by tests because API lacks version selection.
SQL Server columns [name], [status], [operator], and [desc] can be awkward for scans unless explicitly selected or aliased.
JSON columns are varchar(max); repository assembly needs decode errors instead of silently dropping malformed content.
flow_basic_infra and flow_layout_definition are in DDL but have no public fields in ChainDefinition unless future requirements add usage.
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config currently exits 1 in user context; avoid making Docker validation a required gate.

prior_decisions.decision: Plan implementation around xdb repository behavior, not broad engine/compiler changes.
rationale: repository.go and define.go already expose the needed public contracts.

prior_decisions.decision: Use latest active version as the assumed selection contract for DataRepository loads.
rationale: flow_chain_version has identity version_id and status fields.

prior_decisions.decision: Keep ChainDefinition.Endpoints empty for xdb output unless future schema adds endpoint rows.
rationale: sql.mssql.sql has no endpoint table or endpoint columns.
Adding synthesized endpoints would be speculative.

prior_decisions.decision: Include tests before production edits in the DAG.
rationale: Existing xdb code is skeletal and version-selection behavior is ambiguous.
Contract tests prevent implementing a plausible but unverified mapping.
